body.en: The campus screening starts soon, but the coffee, the projector lens and the final film reel are still on the way. You are the last courier on shift.
body.zh: 校园露天电影马上开场，可咖啡、放映镜头和最后一卷胶片还在路上。今晚值班的快递员，只剩你一个。

body.en: Hold Q to slow blue clock-tagged devices for up to 3 seconds. Each delivery gives you only a few uses, counted at the bottom left. You and your delivery clock keep moving normally.
body.zh: 按住 Q，让带蓝色时钟标记的装置减速，每次最长 3 秒。每一单只能用几次，剩余次数显示在左下角。你和配送倒计时都照常进行。

body.en: Start in the practice yard. There is no timer yet.
body.zh: 先在练习区试一试，现在还没有倒计时。

text.en: WASD to move, mouse to look. Hold Shift to sprint to the marked spot.
text.zh: WASD 移动，鼠标看方向。按住 Shift 冲刺到标记处。

text.en: Press Space to jump over the low step.
Sprint, then press Ctrl to slide under the low beam.
text.zh: 先冲刺，再按 Ctrl 从低横梁下滑铲过去。

text.en: Cross after the cart has passed. Hold Q if you want a longer gap. Both ways are safe.
text.zh: 等运输车开过去再通过。想延长空隙可以按住 Q，两种方法都可以。

text.en: Reach the parcel desk and press E to read your first order.
text.zh: 走到取件台，按 E 查看第一份订单。

brief.en: Bring the warm coffee box to the stand before it cools. Delivery carts roll out of the depot doors across the square; wait for a gap.
brief.zh: 趁热把保温箱送到咖啡摊。运输车会从车库门开出来穿过广场，等空隙再走。

delivered.en: Coffee is ready. Next up: the projector lens.
delivered.zh: 咖啡准备好了。下一单：投影镜头。

brief.en: The projectionist left the lens case here at the coffee stand. It is fragile: a cart bump or a fall knocks it, and the third knock cracks it. Take it through the garden to the projection booth.
brief.zh: 放映员把镜头盒落在了咖啡摊。它很娇贵：被运输车撞到或摔下去都会磕一下，第三次就会裂开。把它穿过花园送到投影台。

delivered.en: The projector is ready. One last reel to deliver.
delivered.zh: 投影机准备好了。还差最后一卷胶片。

brief.en: The final reel has just reached the projection booth, and the whole square is waiting. Run it to the clocktower console before the screening starts.
brief.zh: 最后一卷胶片刚送到投影台，全场都在等。开场前把它送到钟楼控制台。

delivered.en: All three deliveries made. Time to take your seat.
delivered.zh: 三份急件全部送达。现在，轮到你入座了。

run_only.en: Progress lasts for this session. Quitting starts a new run.
run_only.zh: 进度在本次运行中保留，退出后重新开始。

ending_body.en: The film begins. Your three delivery stamps make one ticket. Tonight, there is a seat for you too.
ending_body.zh: 放映开始。三枚配送邮戳，拼成了你的电影票。今晚，也有一个座位属于你。

poster_joke.en: Do not use the Borrower to extend exams.
poster_joke.zh: 请勿用借秒器延长考试。
